/*
 * typeset.css — the neokapi "typeset" prose layer.
 *
 * Implements the shadcn/typeset contract
 * (https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/changelog/2026-07-typeset): one CSS file that
 * styles everything inside a `.typeset` container, driven by three controls —
 *
 *   --typeset-size     base text size (everything else derives from it)
 *   --typeset-leading  line-height / vertical rhythm
 *   --typeset-flow     space between blocks
 *
 * Design rules carried over from upstream:
 *   • zero-specificity `:where()` selectors, so a caller's own utility class
 *     (Tailwind) or a `not-typeset` subtree always wins;
 *   • `@layer components`, so Tailwind's `utilities` layer overrides it;
 *   • `margin-block-start`-only flow (stream-stable — appending a block never
 *     reflows the one above it), no `:last-child` / `:has()`;
 *   • colors map to our theme tokens, so it themes light/dark for free.
 *
 * Owned + editable per the typeset philosophy ("the file lives in your
 * project"). Rendering is done by react-markdown; this only styles the output.
 * See web/docs/contribute/implementation/repo/markdown-in-ui.md.
 *
 * Usage: wrap rendered markdown/HTML in `.typeset` (optionally a variant like
 * `.typeset-docs`). Opt a subtree out with `not-typeset` / `data-not-typeset`.
 */

@layer components {
  .typeset {
    --typeset-font-body: inherit;
    --typeset-font-heading: var(--font-sans, inherit);
    --typeset-font-mono: var(--font-mono, ui-monospace, monospace);
    --typeset-size: 1em;
    --typeset-leading: 1.7;
    --typeset-flow: 1.1em;

    font-family: var(--typeset-font-body);
    font-size: var(--typeset-size);
    line-height: var(--typeset-leading);
    color: var(--foreground);
    overflow-wrap: break-word;
  }

  /* Variants — override only the three controls. */
  .typeset-docs {
    --typeset-size: 0.875rem;
    --typeset-leading: 1.7;
    --typeset-flow: 0.75em;
  }
  .typeset-chat {
    --typeset-leading: 1.6;
    --typeset-flow: 0.9em;
  }

  /* ── Flow: each block gets top space; the first child does not. ────────── */
  :where(.typeset > * + *) {
    margin-block-start: var(--typeset-flow);
  }

  /* ── Headings — sizes derive from --typeset-size. ──────────────────────── */
  :where(.typeset h1, .typeset h2, .typeset h3, .typeset h4, .typeset h5, .typeset h6) {
    font-family: var(--typeset-font-heading);
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1.25;
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  :where(.typeset h1) {
    font-size: calc(var(--typeset-size) * 1.5);
  }
  :where(.typeset h2) {
    font-size: calc(var(--typeset-size) * 1.3);
  }
  :where(.typeset h3) {
    font-size: calc(var(--typeset-size) * 1.15);
  }
  :where(.typeset h4, .typeset h5, .typeset h6) {
    font-size: var(--typeset-size);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  }
  /* A heading opens a section: more space above, less below. */
  :where(.typeset :is(h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6) + *) {
    margin-block-start: calc(var(--typeset-flow) * 0.5);
  }

  /* ── Emphasis. ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  :where(.typeset strong) {
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  :where(.typeset em) {
    font-style: italic;
  }

  /* ── Links. ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  :where(.typeset a) {
    color: var(--primary);
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-underline-offset: 2px;
    text-decoration-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 40%, transparent);
  }
  :where(.typeset a:hover) {
    text-decoration-color: var(--primary);
  }

  /* ── Lists. ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  :where(.typeset ul) {
    padding-inline-start: 1.4em;
    list-style: disc;
  }
  :where(.typeset ol) {
    padding-inline-start: 1.4em;
    list-style: decimal;
  }
  :where(.typeset li + li) {
    margin-block-start: calc(var(--typeset-flow) * 0.35);
  }
  :where(.typeset li > ul, .typeset li > ol) {
    margin-block-start: calc(var(--typeset-flow) * 0.35);
  }

  /* ── Code. ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  :where(.typeset :not(pre) > code) {
    font-family: var(--typeset-font-mono);
    font-size: 0.9em;
    background: var(--muted);
    border-radius: calc(var(--radius) * 0.5);
    padding: 0.1em 0.35em;
  }
  :where(.typeset pre) {
    font-family: var(--typeset-font-mono);
    font-size: 0.85em;
    line-height: 1.6;
    background: var(--muted);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    padding: 0.85em 1em;
    overflow-x: auto;
  }
  :where(.typeset pre code) {
    background: none;
    padding: 0;
    font-size: inherit;
  }

  /* ── Blockquote. ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  :where(.typeset blockquote) {
    border-inline-start: 2px solid var(--border);
    padding-inline-start: 0.9em;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-style: italic;
  }

  /* ── Rule. ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  :where(.typeset hr) {
    border: 0;
    border-block-start: 1px solid var(--border);
    margin-block-start: calc(var(--typeset-flow) * 1.4);
  }

  /* ── Tables (scroll on overflow rather than break the page). ───────────── */
  :where(.typeset table) {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    overflow-x: auto;
    border-collapse: collapse;
    font-size: 0.95em;
  }
  :where(.typeset thead) {
    border-block-end: 2px solid var(--border);
  }
  :where(.typeset th) {
    text-align: start;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    padding: 0.35em 0.75em 0.35em 0;
  }
  :where(.typeset td) {
    border-block-end: 1px solid var(--border);
    padding: 0.35em 0.75em 0.35em 0;
    vertical-align: top;
  }

  /* ── Media. ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  :where(.typeset img) {
    max-width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    border-radius: calc(var(--radius) * 0.75);
  }

  /* ── Opt-out: a marked subtree drops back to plain flow. Because every rule
   *    above is zero-specificity :where(), a component's own styles already
   *    win; this resets the inherited rhythm/spacing for good measure. ─────── */
  :where(.typeset .not-typeset),
  :where(.typeset [data-not-typeset]) {
    --typeset-flow: 0px;
  }
  :where(.typeset .not-typeset > * + *),
  :where(.typeset [data-not-typeset] > * + *) {
    margin-block-start: 0;
  }
}
